using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

class Program
{
    private static int total;
    private static int row;
    private static int col;
    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        total = 0;
        for (row = 1; row <= 3; row++)
        {
            for (col = 1; col <= 3; col++)
            {
                total = (total + col);
            }
            Console.WriteLine(total);
        }
    }
}
